long_biography.plain_text:
Kutayba Alghanim grew up in Kuwait and studied at the University of California, Berkeley. Rather than immediately enter the family company, he returned home and opened Al-Dar, a furniture retailer financed independently. In 1971 his father, Yusuf Alghanim, asked him to help address a liquidity crisis at the business that earlier generations had built, and he became managing director.

Alghanim introduced professional management, automated financial systems and a more open organisational culture. Under his leadership, Alghanim Industries developed into a diversified multinational group spanning automotive distribution, retail, manufacturing, engineering, food, finance and transport. He now serves as executive chairman, setting the group's strategy while professional executives manage operations. His record therefore combines inherited ownership of an established enterprise with a documented role in modernising and expanding it.
